sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Samuel T. Kane.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Kane worked for the American Fork Police Department from July 1, 2019, to February 11, 2020.
After leaving American Fork, Kane worked for Utah Adult Probation and Parole and Juvenile Justice and Youth Services. He joined the Sunset City Police Department in May 2025.
